questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic signals are ahead. Yellow signs alert you to conditions coming up on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a left turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop if one is coming. Never try to beat a train across the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns you about a curve to the right ahead. Yellow signs alert you to conditions coming up on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows that the road will make a sharp turn to the right and then a sharp turn to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that you are entering or approaching a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and obey the posted speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs are used only for construction and maintenance warnings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead is now divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians go first. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows rules drivers must follow. It means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells drivers what they must or must not do. It means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a downgrade or hill ahead. The slope may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting and you should stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on roadways. You must come to a complete stop at a stop sign. Do not proceed until it is completely safe to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that a lane will end ahead. Traffic must merge to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or respond to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You will often see this at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Round yellow warning signs are used only to warn about upcoming railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks where a no passing zone begins.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is beginning ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end ahead. Drivers in that lane must merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers to slow down. The road is about to turn sharply at a severe angle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns that the road curves right and then curves left. Drivers should slow down and be ready for these curves.
